==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am talking to someone about ogres and Sentai Rangers. I am not sure who I am talking to. I am not sure why I am talking to them.

I don't have a body. I am simply a voice in the ether. I can summon ghostly images of what I am talking about in the environment.

I wrote a story based on Anime 5e yesterday. Anime 5e is about adding anime flare to D&D 5e. That is probably what influenced my dream.
